value.signature: fn dependency_commitment (id : & ActId , proposal : & ProposalCommitment , salt : & SecretSlice < u8 > , list : & SecretBox < DependencyIds > ,) -> Result < DependencyCommitment , ProfileError >

review.body: { if ! valid_id (id) { return Err (ProfileError :: Representation) ; } salt_format (salt) ? ; let (list , _) = dependencies (list , None) ? ; let digest = hash (DEPENDENCY_RECIPE , "PN-dependency-v2" , vec ! [public (identifier (id)) , anchor (proposal) ?, SecretValue :: Bytes (salt . clone ()) , list ,] ,) ? ; Ok (DependencyCommitment { recipe : DEPENDENCY_RECIPE . into () , bytes : publish (& digest) ? , }) }
review.item_premise: The public body, identity and final commitments are recorded completely. Content pairs, both nonces, salts, dependency lists and pre-digests stay in secrecy carriers with redacted Debug; only the admitted final residues, representation refusals and explicit carriage-equality result leave their inventoried boundaries. No entropy, freshness or authority is inferred.
